$comment: Settings for tools/sync. vendorDir: where tier 1 and 2 files are vendored, under their upstream paths. reportDir: sync reports.
watch: upstream roots whose added, renamed and deleted paths the report lists. verify: test projects run against the vendored tree
(dotnet test with -p:VendoredRoot=<tree>/), each of which must report counts, at least one test and no failures.
